originalGroup.material:
Tea Leaf Display 012

For culture week, our class displayed three kinds of tea leaves. One family brought dried leaves from their own garden. A shop donated two sealed packets. We first wrote "All grown locally" because all the leaves had reached us from people in town. Then a parent pointed out that a local shop could sell tea grown far away. We checked the packets and changed the labels. The garden leaves were marked with the family’s permission. The shop packets listed their printed growing regions. originalGroup.material:
Sports Video Slow Motion 012

The PE club filmed a relay exchange to help pupils improve. In normal speed, the pass looked quick. When the clip was slowed down, a pupil said the receiver had waited far too long. The coach reminded the group that slow motion stretches every part of the action. The length on the screen was not the same as the real waiting time.
They watched the clip with a timer showing the original seconds. It revealed a short pause, but not the long delay some pupils had imagined. They also checked a view from the side because one runner’s arm blocked the front camera. The club used both views to choose one improvement: the receiver would show an open hand earlier. They did not post the clip publicly. It was kept in the school account for the team’s next practice, with the pupils’ agreement.

originalGroup.material:
School Meal Recipe Change 012

The kitchen changed its vegetable soup recipe because one ingredient was unavailable. The replacement had a similar colour, so the soup looked almost the same. A kitchen assistant suggested leaving the menu unchanged to avoid confusing pupils. The manager disagreed. Appearance did not tell diners what was inside.
The team updated the ingredient list and told teachers before lunch. Pupils with recorded food restrictions received their usual individually checked meal. The kitchen did not assume that a familiar-looking soup was suitable for them. A notice also said that the replacement was for this week only. When the original ingredient returned, staff would check and update the list again. In the review, the manager praised the early suggestion because discussing it had made the communication gap visible before serving began.
